entities.summary: Rodrigo Pacheco Méndez is a Mexican professional tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of world No. 196 achieved on 22 September 2025 and a doubles ranking of No. 132 achieved on 2 March 2026. He is currently the No. 1 singles player from Mexico.
